prompt: I ___ Omar.
context: The speaker is introducing himself now.
explanationAr: مع الضمير I بنستخدم am، فنقول: “I am Omar.”

prompt: Mona ___ a new notebook.
context: This sentence describes what Mona has now.
explanationAr: مع Mona، وهي مفرد، بنستخدم has: “Mona has a new notebook.”

prompt: This is ___ eraser.
context: Choose the indefinite article for one eraser.
explanationAr: لما بنقول ممحاة واحدة باستخدام أداة نكرة، بنستخدم an عشان كلمة eraser بتبدأ بصوت متحرك: “This is an eraser.”

prompt: Two ___ are on the desk.
context: The sentence describes two classroom objects.
explanationAr: بعد two بنستخدم الاسم في الجمع: “Two books.”

prompt: Ali and I are students. ___ are in Room 2.
context: The missing pronoun refers to Ali and me together.
explanationAr: لما بتكلم عن نفسي وعن علي مع بعض، بنستخدم We، يعني إحنا: “We are in Room 2.”

prompt: I need to write my name. I use a ___.
context: Choose the classroom object that you write with.
explanationAr: بنكتب الاسم بالقلم الرصاص، يعني pencil.

prompt: I carry my books on my back in a ___.
context: Choose the object a student can carry on their back.
explanationAr: الـ bag هي الشنطة اللي بنحط فيها الكتب ونشيلها.

prompt: The teacher writes words on the ___ on the classroom wall.
context: Everyone in the class can see the words.
explanationAr: المدرّس بيكتب الكلمات على السبورة اللي على حيط الفصل. السبورة بالإنجليزي board.

prompt: I made a wrong pencil mark. I need an ___.
context: Choose the object used to remove a pencil mark.
explanationAr: بنستخدم eraser عشان نمسح علامة القلم الرصاص.

prompt: You meet a new classmate and say, “___, I’m Dina.”
explanationAr: لما نقابل حد، نبدأ التحية بـ “Hello.”

prompt:
A: Hello. What’s your name?
B: ___
context: Choose a natural answer that gives the speaker’s name.
explanationAr: السؤال عن الاسم، والإجابة الطبيعية هي “I’m Hany.”

prompt:
A: Could I borrow a pencil, please?
B: ___
context: Choose a polite response from someone who is lending the pencil.
explanationAr: لما توافق وتدي القلم، الرد الطبيعي هو “Sure. Here you are.”

prompt:
A: Is this your bag?
B: Yes, ___.
explanationAr: السؤال بـ Is this، فنردّ “Yes, it is.”

prompt:
A: This is my friend Salma.
B: ___
context: Choose a polite response when meeting Salma for the first time.
explanationAr: لما نتعرّف على شخص لأول مرة، بنقول “Nice to meet you.”

prompt:
A: Where is the English class?
B: ___
context: The class is in Room 5.
explanationAr: السؤال عن مكان الفصل، والإجابة المناسبة “It’s in Room 5.”

prompt: What does Nabil have?
context: Hello, I’m Nabil. I am a new student. My class is in Room 6. I have a blue bag and two notebooks.
options: A blue chair and a notebook
A blue bag and two notebooks
A red bag and one book
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن مع نبيل “a blue bag and two notebooks.”

prompt: Where is the English class today?
context:
CLASSROOM NOTICE
English class is in Room 3 today. Please bring your book. The class starts at 9:00.
explanationAr: الإشعار بيقول إن حصة الإنجليزي النهارده “in Room 3.”

prompt: Which object is on Rania’s desk?
context: My name is Rania. I sit by the window. My desk has a pencil, an eraser, and a ruler. I do not have a dictionary.
explanationAr: رانية بتقول إن على مكتبها “a ruler”، ومش معاها قاموس.

prompt: Which room is Ms. Hala in?
context: Hello, I’m Samir. This is my teacher, Ms. Hala. She is in Room 2. My friend Karim is in Room 5.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن Ms. Hala موجودة في “Room 2.”

prompt: Where is the teacher’s desk?
context:
WELCOME TO THE ENGLISH ROOM
There are twelve chairs and one large table. The teacher’s desk is near the board. Our books are on the table.
explanationAr: اللافتة بتقول إن مكتب المدرّس “near the board.”

prompt: My sister ___ a nurse.
context: Choose the correct word to complete this present-simple sentence.
explanationAr: مع “my sister” نستخدم “is”، فالجملة الصحيحة: “My sister is a nurse.”

prompt: We ___ two children.
context: Choose the correct word to complete this present-simple sentence.
explanationAr: مع “we” نستخدم “have”، فالجملة الصحيحة: “We have two children.”

prompt: This is ___ photo of my uncle Omar.
context: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.
explanationAr: كلمة “photo” اسم مفرد وبتبدأ بصوت ساكن، فبنستخدم قبلها “a”: “This is a photo of my uncle Omar.”

prompt: The girls ___ long hair.
context: Choose the correct present-simple verb. The subject is plural.
explanationAr: الفاعل “the girls” جمع، فنستخدم “have”: “The girls have long hair.”

prompt: I am showing you one man in this photo. ___ is my father.
context: Choose the correct subject pronoun for one man.
explanationAr: لما نتكلم عن رجل واحد نستخدم “he”: “He is my father.”

prompt: My mother's brother is my ___.
context: Choose the correct family word.
explanationAr: أخو الأم هو الخال، وبالإنجليزي بنقول “uncle”. نفس الكلمة بالإنجليزي بتتقال كمان على العم، بس المقصود هنا الخال.

prompt: Mona is not tall. She is ___.
context: Choose the word that means the opposite of “tall” when describing a person's height.
explanationAr: عكس “tall” في وصف الطول هو “short”، يعني قصيرة.

prompt: My brother's daughter is my ___.
context: Choose the correct family word.
explanationAr: بنت الأخ أو الأخت هي “niece”.

prompt: Ali has no hair on his head. He is ___.
context: Choose the word that describes Ali's appearance.
explanationAr: الشخص اللي ما عندوش شعر على رأسه يوصف بكلمة “bald”.

prompt: My father's mother is my ___.
context: Choose the correct family word.
explanationAr: أم الأب هي “grandmother”، يعني الجدة.

prompt: A: Who is the woman in the photo? B: ___
context: The woman is the speaker's aunt.
explanationAr: الست اللي في الصورة هي عمة أو خالة المتكلم، فالرد المناسب هو “She is my aunt.” بنستخدم “she” لما نتكلم عن ست واحدة.

prompt: A: How many brothers do you have? B: ___
context: The speaker has exactly one brother.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب هو “I have one brother”، وده يجاوب عن العدد.

prompt: A: Is this your sister? B: ___
context: The person is the speaker's sister.
explanationAr: لما نتكلم عن الأخت نستخدم “she”، فالرد الصحيح “Yes, she is.”

prompt: A: Please describe your brother. B: ___
context: Choose a natural description of a person.
options: She is tall and has black hair.
He is tall and has black hair.
He is tall and have black hair.
He are tall and have black hair.
explanationAr: الوصف الصحيح هو “He is tall and has black hair.”؛ بنستخدم “is” و“has” مع “he”.

prompt: A: Where is your family photo? B: ___
context: The photo is on the table.
explanationAr: لما تكون الصورة فوق سطح الترابيزة نقول “on the table”.

prompt: Who is Karim?
context: My name is Salma. I live with my husband, Karim, and our daughter, Lina. Lina is six years old.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن كريم هو زوج سلمى، يعني “Salma's husband”.

prompt: What should students bring to class?
context: NOTICE: Family Photo Day is Monday. Bring one family photo to class.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيطلب من الطلاب يجيبوا “one family photo” للفصل.

prompt: How old is Mona?
context: My name is Omar. I have two sisters, Huda and Mona. Huda is 25, and Mona is 20.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن منى عمرها 20 سنة.

prompt: Who is a student?
context: Nadia's family has four people: Nadia, her mother, her father, and her brother Samir. They live in a small flat. Samir is a student.
explanationAr: المعلومة موجودة بوضوح: “Samir is a student.”

prompt: What does Dalia look like?
context: Hi Rania, I'm with my aunt Dalia today. She has short gray hair and glasses. We are at home.
options: She is tall and has blue eyes.
She has no hair and wears a hat.
She has short gray hair and glasses.
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن داليا عندها شعر رمادي قصير وبتلبس نظارة.

prompt: I ___ in a small flat near the station.
context: The speaker is describing where they live now.
explanationAr: مع الضمير I بنستخدم am، فالجملة الصحيحة: I am in a small flat.

prompt: There is ___ sofa in the living room.
context: The speaker is mentioning this sofa for the first time.
explanationAr: كلمة sofa مفردة وبتبدأ بصوت ساكن، فبنستخدم a: a sofa.

prompt: My parents ___ a large bedroom.
explanationAr: مع My parents بنستخدم have، فالصحيح: My parents have a large bedroom.

prompt: The two ___ are upstairs.
context: Choose the correct plural form of room.
explanationAr: جمع room هو rooms، فالصحيح: The two rooms are upstairs.

prompt: ___ bedroom is on the left.
context: Nadia and her brother live in this house. The speaker lives in another house.
explanationAr: بنتكلم عن غرفة نادية وأخوها، فبنستخدم Their: Their bedroom.

prompt: Which room is it?
context: You prepare breakfast and cook meals in this room.
explanationAr: المطبخ هو المكان اللي بنحضّر ونطبخ فيه الأكل: the kitchen.

prompt: Which room is it?
context: You wash your hands and take a shower in this room.
explanationAr: المكان اللي بتستحم فيه هو الحمّام: the bathroom.

prompt: Where do you leave your coat after you enter the home?
context: You put it in the space just inside the front door.
explanationAr: المساحة عند مدخل البيت اسمها the hall، فالمعطف بيكون فيها.

prompt: What is it?
context: It is a piece of furniture where you keep clothes on hangers.
explanationAr: الـ wardrobe دولاب بنعلّق ونحفظ فيه الهدوم.

prompt: What do you pull over a window to make the room dark?
explanationAr: الستارة، أو curtain، بتتسحب على الشباك علشان تخلّي الأوضة أغمق.

prompt: A: “Excuse me, where is the bathroom?” B: “___”
explanationAr: السؤال عن مكان الحمّام، والرد المناسب هو: It's next to the kitchen.

prompt: A: “Could you open the window, please? It's warm in here.” B: “___”
explanationAr: Of course رد طبيعي ومهذّب على طلب فتح الشباك.

prompt: A: “Is this your blue bag?” B: “___”
context: B confirms that the bag belongs to B.
explanationAr: السؤال بيسأل إذا كانت الشنطة بتاعة الشخص اللي بيرد. بما إنه بيأكد إنها بتاعته، الرد المناسب هو Yes, it's mine، يعني: أيوه، دي بتاعتي.

prompt: A: “Where do you keep the clean towels?” B: “___”
explanationAr: السؤال عن مكان الفوط، والرد المناسب هو: In the bathroom cupboard.

prompt: A: “Can I sit here?” B: “___”
explanationAr: Yes, that chair is free رد واضح ومناسب للسؤال عن الجلوس.

prompt: Where does Rana eat breakfast?
context: Rana lives in a small flat. It has one bedroom and a bright kitchen. The bathroom is across from the bedroom. Rana eats breakfast in the kitchen.
explanationAr: القطعة بتقول إن رنا بتاكل الفطار في المطبخ: in the kitchen.

prompt: Which tap should people use today?
context: NOTICE: The water in the kitchen is off today. Please use the bathroom tap.
explanationAr: الإشعار بيطلب استخدام حنفية الحمّام: the bathroom tap.

prompt: Where is Salma's book?
context: Hi Salma, I am home. Your book is on the table in the living room. The front door is open. Please come in. —Dina
options: On the table in the living room
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن الكتاب على الترابيزة في غرفة المعيشة: on the table in the living room.

prompt: Who washes the cups after tea?
context: Every evening, Karim puts his work bag by the door. He hangs his coat in the hall. Then he makes tea in the kitchen. His sister washes the cups after tea.
explanationAr: القطعة بتقول إن أخت كريم هي اللي بتغسل الأكواب: Karim's sister.

prompt: Where is the bathroom in Youssef's home?
context: Youssef has a desk in his bedroom, where he does his English homework. His sister reads in the living room. Their mother cooks dinner in the kitchen. The bathroom is downstairs, beside the kitchen.
explanationAr: مذكور في القطعة إن الحمّام تحت وبجوار المطبخ: downstairs, beside the kitchen.

prompt: I ___ a sandwich for lunch every day.
explanationAr: مع I بنستخدم have، فالجملة الصحيحة هي “I have a sandwich.”

prompt: There ___ three tomatoes in the basket.
explanationAr: لأن tomatoes جمع، بنستخدم are: “There are three tomatoes.”

prompt: Mona buys ___ egg at the market.
explanationAr: كلمة egg اسم مفرد معدود وبتبدأ بصوت متحرك، فبنستخدم معاها an. بنقول “an egg”، يعني بيضة واحدة.

prompt: My brother and I ___ shopping every Friday.
context: This is our regular weekly activity.
explanationAr: “My brother and I” معناها إحنا، ومع we في المضارع البسيط بنستخدم go من غير s. بنقول “My brother and I go shopping every Friday.”

prompt: The rice is ___ the bowl. It is inside the bowl.
explanationAr: كلمة “inside” بتوضح إن الرز جوه الوعاء، فبنقول “in the bowl.”

prompt: We need flour to make bread. Please buy a bag of ___.
context: At the food shop, you are choosing ingredients for bread.
explanationAr: المكوّن المذكور لعمل العيش هو “flour”، يعني دقيق.

prompt: The shop worker puts my food in a paper ___.
context: You have bought several things and need to carry them home.
explanationAr: بنحط المشتريات في “a paper bag” عشان نشيلها.

prompt: This shop sells fish and seafood. It is a ___.
context: You are looking for a place to buy fish.
explanationAr: المكان اللي بيبيع السمك والمأكولات البحرية هو “a fish shop.”

prompt: I pay 100 pounds for food that costs 50 pounds. The 50 pounds I get back is my ___.
context: You are paying for your shopping at the checkout.
explanationAr: الفلوس اللي البائع بيرجعهالك بعد الدفع اسمها “change.”

prompt: I eat soup with a ___.
context: You are choosing something to eat soup with.
explanationAr: بنستخدم “a spoon” عشان ناكل الشوربة.

prompt:
Customer: “How much are the bananas?”
Shopkeeper: “___”
context: You are buying bananas at a fruit shop.
explanationAr: السؤال “How much” عن السعر، والإجابة المناسبة هي “They’re 20 pounds a kilo.”

prompt:
Customer: “Can I have a bottle of water, please?”
Shopkeeper: “___”
context: You are ordering water in a small shop.
explanationAr: لما الزبون يطلب حاجة، الرد الطبيعي هو “Yes, here you are.”

prompt:
Customer: “Excuse me, where is the milk?”
Shopkeeper: “___”
context: You are looking for milk inside a supermarket.
options: It’s in the fridge, next to the cheese.
explanationAr: السؤال بيسأل عن مكان اللبن، فالإجابة المناسبة بتحدد مكانه: “in the fridge, next to the cheese.”

prompt:
Shopkeeper: “Would you like a bag?”
Customer: “___”
context: You have just bought groceries and are at the checkout.
explanationAr: الرد المهذب على عرض الكيس هو “Yes, please.”

prompt:
Customer: “Do you have any eggs?”
Shopkeeper: “___”
context: You are asking about eggs in a food shop.
options: Yes, we do. They’re on the shelf.
explanationAr: السؤال بـ “Do you have” بيرد عليه البائع بـ “Yes, we do.”

prompt: What does Hala buy?
context: Every Saturday, Hala goes to the small shop near her home. She buys eggs and milk. She walks home with one bag.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن هالة بتشتري “eggs and milk.”

prompt: What time is fresh bread ready?
context:
SHOP NOTICE
Fresh bread is ready at 8:00 a.m.
The shop closes at 6:00 p.m. on Friday.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن العيش الطازة بيكون جاهز الساعة “8:00 a.m.”

prompt: What does Omar take to work?
context: Omar has a small fridge. It has apples, cheese, and water. He takes an apple and water to work.
explanationAr: النص بيذكر إن عمر بياخد “an apple and water” للشغل.

prompt: How many oranges does Salma ask for?
context: At the market, Salma asks for six oranges. The seller puts them in a paper bag. She pays with a card.
explanationAr: سلمى طلبت “six oranges”، يعني ست برتقالات.

prompt: What does Nabil not buy?
context: Nabil writes a list before shopping: rice, tomatoes, and tea. At the shop, he buys all three things. He does not buy sugar because it is not on his list.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن نبيل ما اشترش “sugar”، لأنه مش موجود في القائمة.

prompt: Every weekday, Salma ___ at 6:30.
context: Salma follows this routine every weekday.
explanationAr: مع Salma بنضيف s للفعل في المضارع البسيط، فالصحيح: gets up.

prompt: I ___ a small clock beside my bed.
context: The sentence describes what I own.
explanationAr: مع I بنستخدم have، فالصحيح: I have a small clock.

prompt: The first bus leaves ___ 7:15 every morning.
context: The bus has the same departure time every morning.
explanationAr: بنستخدم at مع وقت محدد، فبنقول: at 7:15.

prompt: Nabil and I ___ ready for work now.
context: This describes how Nabil and I feel now.
explanationAr: مع Nabil and I بنستخدم are، فالصحيح: are ready.

prompt: There are three ___ on the kitchen table.
context: The sentence describes three items on the table.
explanationAr: بعد three بنستخدم جمع الاسم، فالصحيح: cups.

prompt: Hany eats breakfast at 7:00. What does he do at 7:00?
context: Hany eats bread and cheese before he goes to work.
options: He has a meal in the morning.
explanationAr: الأكل في الصبح هو breakfast، يعني وجبة الصباح.

prompt: Mona looks at her ___ to check the time before she leaves home.
context: She wears it on her wrist.
explanationAr: الـ watch ساعة بتتلبس في المعصم وبتبيّن الوقت.

prompt: The library opens at 9:00. What does “opens” mean here?
context: People can go into the library from 9:00.
explanationAr: هنا opens معناها إن المكتبة بتبدأ تسمح للناس بالدخول.

prompt: I set my ___ for 6:00 so it wakes me up.
context: It makes a sound at the time I choose.
explanationAr: الـ alarm clock منبّه بيدّي صوت في الوقت اللي بنختاره.

prompt: I wash my ___ in the bathroom before breakfast.
context: I look at it in the mirror.
explanationAr: ببص على وشي في المراية وبغسله، فالكلمة المناسبة face.

prompt:
A: What time do you have breakfast?
B: ___
context: They are talking about B’s usual morning routine.
explanationAr: السؤال عن وقت الفطار، والإجابة الطبيعية هي: At half past seven.

prompt:
A: Can you tell me the time, please?
B: ___
context: It is 8:30 now.
explanationAr: للسؤال عن الوقت، بنقول: It’s half past eight.

prompt:
A: Do you have an alarm clock?
B: ___
context: B owns an alarm clock.
explanationAr: السؤال بـ Do you have إجابته القصيرة هنا: Yes, I do.

prompt:
A: Excuse me, where is the wall clock?
B: ___
context: The clock is on the wall above the door.
explanationAr: السؤال عن مكان الساعة، فالإجابة المناسبة: It’s above the door.

prompt:
A: Is the shop open now?
B: ___
context: The shop opens at 8:00. It is now 8:15, and the shop is open.
explanationAr: السؤال بـ Is the shop open إجابته المناسبة: Yes, it is.

prompt: What time does Sara leave home?
context:
Sara’s Morning
Sara gets up at 6:00 every weekday. She has tea and bread at 6:30. She leaves home at 7:10 and walks to the bus stop.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن Sara بتسيب البيت الساعة 7:10.

prompt: What does Karim do first after he gets up?
context:
Karim’s Morning
Karim gets up at 7:00. First, he washes his face. Then he gets dressed and eats breakfast at 7:30. He starts work at 9:00.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن أول حاجة كريم بيعملها بعد ما بيصحى هي إنه بيغسل وشه.

prompt: What time does the English class start?
context:
At the Community Center
English class: Monday and Wednesday, 5:00–6:00 p.m.
Computer class: Tuesday, 4:00–5:00 p.m.
The center is open every weekday from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
explanationAr: حسب الجدول، حصة الإنجليزي بتبدأ الساعة 5:00 مساءً.

prompt: Where are the keys?
context:
A Note for Salma
Salma, your keys are on the small table by the front door. Your bag is on your bed.
—Dad
options: On the small table by the front door.
explanationAr: الملاحظة بتقول إن المفاتيح على الترابيزة الصغيرة جنب باب البيت. الشنطة هي اللي على السرير.

prompt: When can people use the laundry room?
context:
Laundry Room
The laundry room is open from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. every day. Please put your clothes in a basket. The room is next to the stairs on the first floor.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن غرفة الغسيل مفتوحة كل يوم من 8:00 الصبح لحد 6:00 بالليل.

prompt: The bus ___ at this stop every morning.
context: Choose the simple present form for a daily routine.
explanationAr: مع الفاعل المفرد The bus بنضيف s، فالصحيح stops.

prompt: There ___ two seats near the door.
context: Complete the sentence with the correct form of be. The sentence describes two seats now.
explanationAr: بنستخدم are مع الجمع two seats.

prompt: I go to work ___ bus every day.
context: Complete the sentence with the usual transport expression.
explanationAr: بنقول by bus لما نتكلم عن وسيلة المواصلات.

prompt: The bus stop is ___ the bank and the café.
context: Choose the preposition that describes a place in the middle of two places.
explanationAr: between معناها بين، وبتناسب وجود المكان بين البنك والكافيه.

prompt: ___ your sister have a travel card?
context: Ask about a present fact; use the simple present question form with your sister.
explanationAr: مع your sister بنستخدم Does في سؤال المضارع البسيط، وبعدها have.

prompt: The sign says, “Go straight for 100 metres.” What should you do?
context: You are walking to the bus station and read this direction sign.
explanationAr: Go straight معناها كمل في نفس الاتجاه من غير ما تلف.

prompt: You are at a train station. What is a train?
context: Choose the word for a type of transport.
explanationAr: Train معناها قطر، والقطر وسيلة مواصلات، مش محل أو تذكرة أو شارع.

prompt: I buy a ___ before I get on the train.
context: Choose the word for the paper that lets you travel on the train.
explanationAr: Ticket معناها تذكرة، وهي الورقة اللي بتشتريها عشان تركب القطر.

prompt: At the traffic lights, turn ___. The post office is on that side.
context: The post office is on your left as you face the traffic lights.
explanationAr: بما إن مكتب البريد على شمالك، الاتجاه الصحيح هو left.

prompt: What do we call the person who drives a bus?
context: Choose the word for a person's job.
explanationAr: Driver معناها سواق، وهو الشخص اللي بيسوق الأتوبيس.

prompt: A: Excuse me, ___? B: Yes. It stops near the museum.
context: You want to check the destination before you get on a bus.
options: does this bus go to the museum
explanationAr: السؤال الطبيعي للتأكد من وجهة الأتوبيس هو Does this bus go to the museum?

prompt: A: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station? B: ___.
context: A visitor asks you for directions. The station is one street ahead on the right.
explanationAr: Go straight and turn right بتدي اتجاهات مناسبة للوصول للمحطة.

prompt: A: Where do I get off for the library? B: ___.
context: You are on a bus. The library is at the next stop.
options: Get off at the next stop
Get on at the next stop
explanationAr: السؤال عن المحطة اللي تنزل فيها عشان المكتبة. Get off at the next stop معناها انزل في المحطة الجاية.

prompt: A: Can I help you? B: Yes, ___, please.
context: You are buying a ticket at the station counter. You need one ticket to Cairo.
options: I’d like a ticket to Cairo
I am a ticket to Cairo
explanationAr: I’d like a ticket to Cairo طريقة مهذبة وطبيعية لطلب تذكرة.

prompt: A: Is this the bus for the city centre? B: ___.
context: The driver confirms that this bus goes to the city centre.
explanationAr: السؤال عن this bus، والإجابة المناسبة هي Yes, it is.

prompt: Which bus goes to the City Library?
context:
BUS STOP NOTICE
Route 12: City Library and Market
Route 8: River Park and Museum
Buses come every 20 minutes.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن Route 12 بيروح لمكتبة المدينة.

prompt: Where does the tram to Central Station leave from?
context:
TRAM NOTICE
The tram to Central Station leaves from Gate 3.
Buy your ticket at the machine beside Gate 3.
explanationAr: الإعلان واضح إن الترام لمحطة Central Station بيطلع من Gate 3.

prompt: How does Sami go to work?
context: Sami lives near Green Street. Every weekday, he walks to the bus stop and takes bus 5 to work. He gets off near his office.
explanationAr: سامي بياخد bus 5 كل يوم شغل، يعني بيروح بالأتوبيس.

prompt: What time is the first bus on Saturday?
context:
LOCAL BUS TIMES
Monday to Friday: 8:00, 9:00, 10:00
Saturday: 8:30, 9:30, 10:30
No buses on Sunday.
explanationAr: مواعيد السبت هي 8:30 و9:30 و10:30. أول أتوبيس يوم السبت الساعة 8:30.

prompt: Where is the taxi stand?
context:
WELCOME TO HILL STREET
The train station is opposite the post office.
The taxi stand is beside the train station.
The bus stop is in front of the bank.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن موقف التاكسي بجانب محطة القطر، يعني beside the train station.

prompt: Every cold morning, I ___ a coat before I leave home.
context: The sentence describes a regular habit.
explanationAr: الإجابة هي “wear” لأن الفاعل “I” مع العادة اليومية بياخد الفعل في صورته الأساسية.

prompt: Today, the weather ___ warm.
context: This describes the weather today, not a past day or a future forecast.
explanationAr: بنقول “is” مع “the weather” لأنها مفرد، والجملة بتوصف حالة الجو النهارده.

prompt: I need ___ jacket for this cold walk.
context: The sentence refers to one jacket, without naming a particular jacket.
explanationAr: الإجابة “a jacket” لأننا بنتكلم عن جاكيت واحد غير محدد، وكلمة “jacket” بتبدأ بصوت ساكن.

prompt: Ali and I are cold. ___ need our coats.
explanationAr: بنستخدم “We” عشان تشير إلى علي والمتكلم معًا.

prompt: The gloves are ___ my bag.
context: The gloves are inside the closed bag.
explanationAr: الإجابة “in my bag” لأن الجوانتي جوه الشنطة.

prompt: It is raining. I want to keep my clothes dry, so I put on a ___.
explanationAr: الـ“raincoat” معطف مطر بنلبسه عشان يحمينا من المطر.

prompt: My fingers feel cold. I put on ___ to keep my hands warm.
explanationAr: “Gloves” معناها جوانتي، وبيتلبس في الإيدين.

prompt: These shoes cover my feet and part of my legs. They are ___.
explanationAr: “Boots” يعني بوت، وده نوع من الجزم بيغطي القدم وجزء من الرجل.

prompt: It is cold around my neck, so I wrap a ___ around it.
explanationAr: “Scarf” معناها كوفية أو وشاح، وبتتلف حوالين الرقبة.

prompt: The sun is very bright. I wear ___ to protect my eyes.
explanationAr: “Sunglasses” معناها نظارة شمس، وبتحمي العينين من ضوء الشمس.

prompt: A: Is this your jacket? B: No, ___.
context: The jacket belongs to Ahmed.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب “it's Ahmed's” لأنه بيوضح إن الجاكيت ملك أحمد.

prompt: A: What do you wear when it rains? B: ___.
explanationAr: السؤال عن الملابس المناسبة للمطر، فالرد الطبيعي “I wear a raincoat.”

prompt: A: Please ___ the window. It's cold in here. B: OK.
context: The window is open.
explanationAr: بنقول “close the window” يعني اقفل الشباك، وده مناسب لأن الجو بارد.

prompt: A: How much are these socks? B: ___.
context: The price tag says 50 pounds.
explanationAr: السؤال عن السعر، فالرد المناسب “They are 50 pounds.”

prompt: A: Is it cold outside? B: Yes. Take ___.
context: You are leaving home and the weather is cold.
explanationAr: بما إن الجو بارد، النصيحة المناسبة هي “Take your coat.”

prompt: What should people take with them today?
context:
NOTICE AT THE SCHOOL DOOR
Rain today. Please take an umbrella. Put wet coats on the hooks by the door.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول بوضوح: “Please take an umbrella”، يعني خُدوا شمسية.

prompt: What does Salma wear when she goes to work?
context: Hi, I'm Salma. I live near the sea. The weather is often windy. I wear a blue scarf when I go to work, and I carry a small umbrella in my bag.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن سلمى بتلبس كوفية زرقا لما تروح الشغل: “I wear a blue scarf when I go to work.”

prompt: When does the clothing shop open?
context:
RIVER CLOTHES
Open Monday to Saturday: 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.
Closed Sunday. Coats and shoes are on the first floor.
explanationAr: مواعيد المحل في الإعلان بتقول إنه بيفتح الساعة “9:00 a.m.”.

prompt: Where is Omar's hat?
context: Omar is getting ready for work. It is cold today. His coat is on the chair, his hat is in the hall, and his boots are by the door.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن قبعة عمر “in the hall”، يعني في الردهة.

prompt: What does Nina put on before breakfast?
context:
Nina's note:
The morning is cool, but the afternoon is sunny. I put on a light sweater before breakfast. I take my sunglasses in my bag for later.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن نينا بتلبس بلوفر خفيف قبل الفطار: “I put on a light sweater before breakfast.”

prompt: I ___ chess with my brother every Friday.
context: Use the simple present for a regular activity.
explanationAr: مع الفاعل I بنستخدم الفعل في صورته الأساسية: “play”.

prompt: Mona has ___ guitar.
context: Mona has one guitar. We do not mean a particular guitar known to the reader.
explanationAr: بنتكلم عن جيتار واحد مش محدد للقارئ. بنستخدم “a” قبل الاسم المفرد المعدود اللي بيبدأ بصوت ساكن: “a guitar”.

prompt: My friends ___ in the living room now.
context: Choose the present form of be for the plural subject “my friends.”
explanationAr: مع “my friends” بنستخدم “are”: “My friends are”.

prompt: Ali is my brother. ___ hobby is drawing.
context: Choose the possessive adjective that refers to Ali.
explanationAr: علي هو أخو المتكلم، فبنستخدم “His” بمعنى «بتاعه»: “His hobby” يعني هوايته.

prompt: I need two ___ for my painting class.
context: Choose the correct plural form of “brush.”
explanationAr: الجمع الصحيح لكلمة “brush” هو “brushes”.

prompt: I take pictures of my family with my ___.
context: I hold it in my hand and use it to take photos.
explanationAr: بنستخدم “camera” لالتقاط الصور.

prompt: I make meals for my family because I enjoy ___.
context: Choose the word for preparing food.
explanationAr: “Cooking” معناها الطبخ، وهو تحضير الأكل.

prompt: I play music on a ___. It has black and white keys.
context: Choose the name of the thing used to play music.
explanationAr: “Piano” يعني بيانو، وده بنعزف عليه موسيقى وليه مفاتيح سودا وبيضا.

prompt: I go to the pool every week. Swimming is my favorite ___.
context: Choose the word that means an enjoyable thing you do.
explanationAr: “Activity” معناها نشاط، والسباحة نشاط بتحبه.

prompt: The football game is on the green ___ beside the park gate.
context: Choose the word for an area of grass used for games.
explanationAr: “Field” معناها ملعب أو مساحة أرض للعب.

prompt:
“Would you like to play chess with me?”
“___”
context: Choose a friendly way to accept the invitation.
explanationAr: “Yes, I’d love to” رد طبيعي للموافقة على الدعوة.

prompt:
“Can you come to my house at six?”
“Sorry, I can’t. ___”
context: I have an English class at six.
options: I have an English class then.
explanationAr: “I have an English class then” بتوضح سبب عدم القدرة على المجيء.

prompt:
“What time does the art club start?”
“___”
context: The art club starts at five o’clock.
explanationAr: السؤال عن الوقت، والإجابة المناسبة هي “At five o’clock”.

prompt:
“Can I borrow your colored pencils?”
“___”
context: You are happy to lend them and hand them over now.
explanationAr: “Sure, here you are” رد طبيعي عند إعارة الأقلام وتسليمها.

prompt:
“Where do you play basketball?”
“___”
context: Choose the answer that gives a place.
options: At the sports center on King Street.
explanationAr: السؤال بـ “Where” عن المكان، والإجابة بتحدد مكان اللعب.

prompt: When is the art club?
context:
ART CLUB NOTICE
Come to the art club every Tuesday from 4:00 to 5:00 p.m. We meet in Room 2. Bring your pencils.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن نادي الفن بيكون كل ثلاثاء من 4 لـ5.

prompt: How many tennis rackets does Salma have?
context:
Hi Omar,
I play tennis on Saturday. Come and play with me! I have two tennis rackets.
Salma
explanationAr: سلمى بتقول “I have two tennis rackets”، يعني عندها مضربين تنس.

prompt: What can visitors do at the book swap?
context:
BOOK SWAP
Friday, 2:00–4:00 p.m. in the library hall.
Bring one book and take one book. Everyone is welcome.
options: Bring two books and take no books.
Take a book home on Thursday.
Bring one book and take one book.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيطلب من الزوار يجيبوا كتاب واحد وياخدوا كتاب واحد.

prompt: When does Rami swim?
context: Rami likes drawing and swimming. He draws after school on Mondays. He swims with his brother on Saturdays.
explanationAr: النص بيقول إن رامي بيسبح مع أخوه يوم السبت: “on Saturdays”.

prompt: Where does Maha invite Dina to meet?
context:
Hi Dina,
Let’s meet at the café near the library at 3:00 on Sunday. We can talk and draw.
Maha
options: At the café near the library.
explanationAr: مها بتقترح المقابلة في “the café near the library”.

prompt: Mona ___ a new notebook for class.
explanationAr: بنستخدم has مع Mona لأنها مفرد غائب.

prompt: At this moment, the players ___ in the gym.
explanationAr: بنستخدم are مع players لأنها جمع، وعبارة at this moment بتوضح إننا بنتكلم عن دلوقتي.

prompt: I need ___ orange ball for today's game.
context: The speaker needs any orange ball, not a particular one.
explanationAr: بنستخدم an قبل orange لأنها بتبدأ بصوت متحرك، والكرة مش محددة.

prompt: These ___ are for our science books.
explanationAr: بعد These بنستخدم اسم جمع؛ جمع box هو boxes.

prompt: My friends and I are on the team. The coach talks to ___ after practice.
explanationAr: بنستخدم us بعد talks to؛ الضمير هنا مفعول به.

prompt: I use a ___ to carry my books to school.
explanationAr: كلمة backpack معناها شنطة ظهر، ودي بنحط فيها الكتب ونشيلها.

prompt: Sara plays football. She kicks the ___ into the goal.
explanationAr: في كرة القدم، سارة بتشوط الكرة في الجون. كلمة ball معناها كرة.

prompt: Mr Hassan explains maths to our class. He is our ___.
explanationAr: الشخص اللي بيشرح الرياضيات للفصل هو teacher، يعني مُعلّم.

prompt: The school team plays basketball indoors in the ___.
explanationAr: كلمة gym معناها صالة رياضية، ودي مكان داخلي مناسب للعب كرة السلة.

prompt: I wear these on my feet for PE. They have laces and help me run.
explanationAr: trainers هي أحذية رياضية برباط، وبتناسب الجري وحصة الرياضة.

prompt:
Rana: I don't have a pencil. Can I use yours?
Salma: ___
context: Salma agrees and gives Rana her pencil.
explanationAr: سلمى موافقة وبتدي رنا القلم، فبتقول Yes. Here you are، يعني أيوه، اتفضلي.

prompt:
Student: Excuse me, where is the library?
Teacher: ___
explanationAr: السؤال عن مكان المكتبة، فالرد المناسب هو It's beside the computer room.

prompt:
Coach: Do you play volleyball on Thursdays?
Hany: ___
context: Hany plays volleyball every Thursday.
explanationAr: هاني بيلعب الكرة الطائرة كل خميس، فبيرد بالإيجاب. لما السؤال يبدأ بـ Do you، الرد القصير المناسب هو Yes, I do.

prompt:
Mai: Can I borrow your ruler, please?
Dina: ___
explanationAr: Sure. Here you are رد مهذب وطبيعي لما حد يطلب استعارة المسطرة.

prompt:
Teacher: Please open your books to page ten.
Students: ___
explanationAr: All right رد مناسب على طلب المعلم بفتح الكتب.

prompt: When does Laila have PE?
context: Laila is in Class 5. She has art on Monday and PE on Wednesday. She keeps her PE shoes in a red bag.
explanationAr: القطعة بتقول إن Laila عندها PE on Wednesday، يعني يوم الأربعاء.

prompt: Where does the swimming club meet?
context: SCHOOL SPORTS NOTICE: The swimming club meets in the small pool on Tuesday at 3:00 p.m. Bring a towel.
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن نادي السباحة بيجتمع in the small pool.

prompt: Who walks to school with Karim?
context: Karim walks to school with his brother. His first lesson is English. After lunch, he plays basketball in the playground.
explanationAr: القطعة بتقول إن Karim بيمشي للمدرسة مع أخوه: his brother.

prompt: On which day does Nour practise tennis?
context: Nour's sports timetable: Monday—tennis; Wednesday—football; Friday—basketball. Practice starts at 4 p.m. each day.
explanationAr: حسب جدول Nour، تدريب التنس يوم Monday، يعني الاثنين.

prompt: Where should students return borrowed books?
context: SCHOOL LIBRARY: Open Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. Return borrowed books to the desk by Thursday.
explanationAr: إعلان المكتبة بيطلب إن الكتب المستعارة ترجع to the desk.

prompt: Yesterday, we ___ the old town during our holiday.
context: The visit happened yesterday and is finished.
explanationAr: كلمة yesterday بتوضح إن الزيارة حصلت وخلصت، فالصيغة الصح هي visited.

prompt: At the moment, Salma ___ photos of the beach.
context: Salma is taking the photos right now.
explanationAr: عبارة at the moment معناها إن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي، فالصيغة الصح هي is taking.

prompt: I think it ___ sunny tomorrow.
context: Nour is making a prediction about tomorrow's weather.
explanationAr: نور بتتوقع حالة الجو بكرة، فالصيغة المناسبة للتوقع هي will be.

prompt: The ferry was ___ than the bus, so we arrived later.
context: The sentence compares how fast the ferry and the bus were on the same trip.
explanationAr: وجود than للمقارنة بيحتاج صيغة المقارنة، والصيغة الصح هنا هي slower.

prompt: There was ___ juice for all four of us; we each had one full glass.
context: The juice was sufficient for everyone to have a full glass.
explanationAr: الجملة بتقول إن كل واحد أخد كوباية كاملة، فكمية العصير كانت كافية: enough.

prompt: At the airport, the worker looked at our ___ before we got on the plane.
context: We had these papers with us for our flight.
explanationAr: الـ tickets هي تذاكر السفر اللي العامل بيبص عليها قبل ركوب الطيارة.

prompt: We slept in a tent at the ___ during our trip.
context: The place had spaces for tents and other people were camping there too.
explanationAr: المكان المخصص لنصب الخيام والتخييم اسمه campsite.

prompt: We used a ___ to find the streets in the old town.
context: It was a paper guide showing the town's streets and places.
explanationAr: الـ map بتوضح الشوارع والأماكن وبتساعدنا نلاقي الطريق.

prompt: The hotel worker gave us a ___ to open our room.
context: We needed it to unlock the door.
explanationAr: الـ key هو المفتاح اللي بنستخدمه لفتح باب الأوضة.

prompt: We bought small gifts to remember our trip and give to friends. They were ___.
context: These little objects were reminders of the holiday.
explanationAr: الهدايا الصغيرة اللي بنشتريها كتذكار من الرحلة اسمها souvenirs.

prompt: Visitor: Excuse me, how do I get to the beach? Local: ___
context: A visitor is asking for directions in town.
options: Go straight and turn right at the bank.
explanationAr: الرد الصح بيدي اتجاهات مباشرة: Go straight and turn right at the bank.

prompt: Nadia: Can you take a photo of us, please? Friend: ___
context: The friends are together at a holiday beach. The friend agrees to take the photo and asks them to stand together.
explanationAr: السياق بيقول إن الصاحب وافق يصوّرهم وطلب منهم يقفوا جنب بعض، فالرد المناسب هو: Of course. Stand together, please.

prompt: Ali: How was your holiday? Huda: ___
options: It was great. We swam every day.
explanationAr: هُدى بتوصف إجازتها، والرد المناسب هو It was great. We swam every day.

prompt: Friend: I feel tired after the long walk. You: ___
context: Your friend has just finished walking around a holiday town.
options: You should sit down and rest.
explanationAr: لما صاحبك يكون تعبان، النصيحة المناسبة هي You should sit down and rest.

prompt: Visitor: What time does the museum open today? Worker: ___
context: The visitor is asking about today's opening time at the museum entrance.
explanationAr: السؤال عن ميعاد الفتح، فالرد المناسب هو It opens at nine.

prompt: What did Hany and his cousin do after lunch?
context: On Saturday, Hany and his cousin went to the beach by bus. They arrived at ten and swam before lunch. After lunch, they rented two bikes and rode along the beach. They went home at five.
options: They rented bikes and rode along the beach.
explanationAr: بعد الغدا، النص بيقول إنهم استأجروا عجلتين وركبوا على طول الشاطئ.

prompt: What time does breakfast finish?
context: Hi Dina, We arrived at the guesthouse safely. Our room is ready after 2 p.m. Breakfast is served from 7:00 to 9:30 each morning. We plan to visit the castle tomorrow. See you, Mona.
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن الفطار من 7:00 لحد 9:30، يعني بيخلص الساعة 9:30.

prompt: Which place did Rana like best?
context: During her three-day holiday in Luxor, Rana visited a temple, a market, and a garden. She liked the garden best because it was quiet and she could read under a tree. She bought fruit at the market and took photos at the temple.
explanationAr: رنا قالت بوضوح إنها حبت الجنينة أكتر مكان لأنها كانت هادية.

prompt: Why did Tarek pack an umbrella?
context: Before leaving for Alexandria, Tarek checked the weather app. It said rain was likely in the afternoon. He packed an umbrella, a book, and a bottle of water. It stayed sunny all morning, but rain started after lunch. Tarek used the umbrella while walking to the train station.
options: He expected rain in the afternoon.
explanationAr: توقع تطبيق الطقس نزول المطر بعد الضهر، وعشان كده طارق حط الشمسيّة في شنطته.

prompt: What did Mariam do while she waited for the train?
context: Mariam's train to Cairo was delayed by 40 minutes. She had already bought a sandwich, so she sat in the waiting room and read a short story on her phone. When the train arrived, she called her sister to say she was getting on. She reached Cairo at 6 p.m.
options: She read a short story on her phone.
She called her sister before she left home.
She went to the station café.
explanationAr: وقت التأخير، مريم قعدت في قاعة الانتظار وقرأت قصة قصيرة على موبايلها.

prompt: I promise I ___ you as soon as I arrive.
context: I haven't reached the station yet, and I am making a promise about what I will do later.
explanationAr: كلمة «promise» هنا بتوضح إن ده وعد للمستقبل، فالصياغة المناسبة هي «will text».

prompt: Please wait a moment. Sara ___ to the clinic right now.
context: Sara is on the road at this moment.
explanationAr: كلمة «right now» بتدل إن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي، فنقول «is driving».

prompt: We ___ the dentist last Monday.
context: The appointment is finished. The time is specifically last Monday.
explanationAr: «Last Monday» وقت ماضي وانتهى، لذلك نقول «saw».

prompt: The clinic near my office is ___ than the one across town: it is a five-minute walk instead of a 30-minute bus ride.
context: Compare the distance and travel time to the two clinics.
explanationAr: بنقارن بين مكانين، والصيغة الصحيحة للمقارنة هنا هي «closer».

prompt: Four visitors are coming, and there are four chairs, so there are ___ chairs for everyone.
context: There is exactly one chair for each visitor.
explanationAr: لما العدد يكفي كل الزوار، بنقول «enough chairs».

prompt: Nadia cannot go to the clinic on Thursday. She calls to ___ her appointment to Friday.
context: She still wants to see the doctor, but on a different day.
explanationAr: «Change» معناها تغيّر، وهنا نادية عايزة تغيّر يوم الموعد من الخميس للجمعة.

prompt: The nurse says, “Please arrive at 9:45 for your 10:00 appointment.” What does “arrive” mean here?
context: The nurse is telling a patient when to come to the clinic.
explanationAr: «Arrive» معناها توصل لمكان، وهنا المقصود الوصول للعيادة.

prompt: The clinic sent me a reminder about my appointment tomorrow. What is a reminder?
context: The message says, “Your appointment is tomorrow at 11 a.m.”
options: a message that helps you remember
a form to fill in at the clinic
a new appointment with a doctor
explanationAr: «A reminder» رسالة بتساعدك تفتكر الموعد، زي رسالة العيادة.

prompt: The 4:30 appointment is available. What does “available” mean here?
context: The receptionist says nobody has booked the 4:30 time yet.
explanationAr: «Available» هنا معناها إن الموعد فاضي وممكن يتحجز.

prompt: There are six people in the queue at the pharmacy. What is the queue?
context: The people are waiting to speak to the pharmacist.
explanationAr: «A queue» هي طابور من الناس مستنيين دورهم.

prompt:
Receptionist: “Good morning. How can I help you?”
Customer: “___”
context: The customer wants to arrange a visit for Tuesday.
options: Could I book an appointment for Tuesday, please?
explanationAr: الطلب الطبيعي لحجز موعد هو «Could I book an appointment for Tuesday, please?».

prompt:
Patient: “I’m sorry, but I’m running ten minutes late.”
Receptionist: “___”
context: The patient has called before the appointment to explain the delay.
options: Thanks for letting us know. Please come as soon as you can.
I was ten minutes late yesterday.
You should book a different doctor.
What time do you usually wake up?
explanationAr: الرد المناسب على الاعتذار عن التأخير هو شكره وطلبه ييجي أول ما يقدر.

prompt:
Omar: “Are you free after work to plan our visit to the dentist?”
Maya: “___”
context: Maya finishes work at five today and is free to meet Omar then.
options: The dentist sent me a reminder this morning.
Yes, I finish at five, so I can meet you then.
I visited the dentist last month.
No, I have to work until eight tonight.
explanationAr: مايا بتخلص شغل الساعة خمسة وفاضية تقابل عمر بعدها، فالرد المناسب إنها توافق وتقول تقدر تقابله إمتى.

prompt:
Lina: “I have a bad headache before my appointment. What should I do?”
Sam: “___”
context: Sam advises Lina to ask the clinic what to do.
options: I called the clinic last week.
Did you enjoy your visit last week?
You should call the clinic and ask them for advice.
explanationAr: لينا بتسأل تعمل إيه، وسام بينصحها تكلم العيادة وتسألهم. «You should» بنستخدمها عشان ندي نصيحة.

prompt:
Customer: “Can I move my appointment to Monday, please?”
Receptionist: “___”
context: There are appointments available on Monday. The receptionist asks which time the customer wants.
options: Please bring your glasses with you.
Of course. What time would you like?
The clinic is next to the bank.
explanationAr: الموظف عنده مواعيد فاضية يوم الاثنين وعايز يعرف الوقت اللي العميل يفضّله، فبيوافق وبيسأله عن الوقت.

prompt: When is Ali's dentist appointment now?
context: Hi Ali, the dentist has changed your appointment. It is now Friday at 11:00 a.m., not Thursday at 11:00 a.m. Please reply to confirm. —Clinic reception
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن الموعد بقى يوم الجمعة الساعة 11 صباحًا.

prompt: What time should Ben leave home to catch the bus?
context: Ben has a check-up at 2:00 p.m. His bus leaves the stop near his home at 1:30 p.m. It takes him 20 minutes to walk from home to that stop. He wants to reach the stop five minutes before the bus leaves.
explanationAr: الأتوبيس بيمشي الساعة 1:30، وبن عايز يوصل قبله بخمس دقايق، يعني 1:25. المشي بياخد عشرين دقيقة، فلازم يسيب البيت الساعة 1:05.

prompt: Why will Rosa meet Kim at 4:30 instead of 4:00?
context: Rosa messages Kim: “My work meeting ends at 4:15, so I can’t meet you at 4:00. Let’s meet at the café at 4:30. I’ll book the table.” Kim replies, “That works for me.”
options: Rosa wants to meet at the clinic.
Kim has a doctor’s appointment at 4:00.
explanationAr: روزا بتقول إن اجتماع الشغل بيخلص الساعة 4:15، عشان كده اقترحت 4:30.

prompt: What should Sam bring to the appointment?
context: Hello Sam, your eye appointment is on Wednesday at 9:30 a.m. Please bring your glasses and the list of medicines you take. You do not need to bring your old test results; we have them here. —Dr. Lee’s office
options: His glasses and a list of his medicines
His glasses and old test results
explanationAr: التعليمات بتطلب من سام يجيب نظارته وقايمة بالأدوية اللي بياخدها.

prompt: How many people are going to the park after the appointment?
context: Mina writes: “My appointment ends at 10:30 on Saturday. After that, I’ll meet Salma and Hany at the park. I’ll bring lunch for Salma and me. Hany will bring his own lunch.”
explanationAr: مينا هتقابل سلمى وهاني في الحديقة، يعني هي وسلمى وهاني: تلاتة أشخاص.

prompt: Yesterday, Hany ___ the doctor because his stomach hurt.
context: The visit happened yesterday and is finished.
explanationAr: استخدمنا “visited” لأن الزيارة حصلت وانتهت امبارح.

prompt: Look! Salma ___ her medicine now.
context: The speaker can see Salma taking the medicine at this moment.
explanationAr: “is taking” هي الصح لأن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي.

prompt: I have just decided to call the clinic. I ___ them now.
context: The speaker is making the decision at the moment of speaking.
explanationAr: “will call” مناسبة لقرار اتاخد في لحظة الكلام.

prompt: This chair is ___ than the one in the waiting room.
context: The speaker is comparing two chairs and means this one is more comfortable.
explanationAr: للمقارنة بين كرسيين بنقول “more comfortable”.

prompt: How ___ tablets should I take each day?
context: The speaker is asking about a number of tablets, which are countable.
explanationAr: “many” بنستخدمها مع الأسماء المعدودة زي “tablets”.

prompt: I booked an ___ with Dr. Nabil for Monday at 10 a.m.
context: The speaker arranged a time to see the doctor.
explanationAr: “appointment” معناها موعد، وهنا موعد مع الدكتور.

prompt: Mariam feels very hot. The thermometer shows 39°C, so she has a high ___.
explanationAr: “temperature” هي درجة حرارة الجسم، و“high temperature” معناها حرارة مرتفعة.

prompt: The doctor gave me a prescription. I will take it to the ___ to get the medicine.
explanationAr: “pharmacy” هي الصيدلية اللي بنصرف منها الدواء.

prompt: Ali cut his finger while cooking. He washed it and put a clean ___ over it.
explanationAr: “bandage” معناها ضمادة، وبتغطي الجرح.

prompt: My back tooth hurts when I eat. I should make an appointment with a ___.
explanationAr: “dentist” هو طبيب الأسنان، وده المناسب لوجع الضرس.

prompt: A: I have a headache and feel tired. What do you suggest? B: ___
context: The speaker wants simple advice for these mild symptoms.
options: You should rest in a quiet room.
explanationAr: “You should rest in a quiet room” نصيحة مناسبة للصداع والتعب.

prompt: A: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest clinic is? B: ___
context: A visitor is asking for directions in the street.
options: It’s next to the bank, on your left.
explanationAr: “It’s next to the bank, on your left” بتدي اتجاه واضح للعيادة.

prompt: A: I’m sorry, I can’t come to work today. I’m feeling ill. B: ___
context: A colleague is replying kindly to a message about illness.
options: It closes at half past five.
I’m sorry to hear that. Get well soon.
explanationAr: “I’m sorry to hear that. Get well soon” رد مهذب ومناسب لزميل مريض.

prompt: A: I need to take these tablets with food, but I haven’t had lunch. B: ___
context: The speaker is offering practical help.
explanationAr: “Would you like a sandwich?” عرض مناسب عشان ياكل قبل الدواء.

prompt: A: Hello. I’d like to book a visit with the doctor, please. B: ___
context: The conversation is at a clinic reception desk.
options: Certainly. What day would you like to come?
explanationAr: “Certainly. What day would you like to come?” رد طبيعي من موظف الاستقبال لحجز موعد.

prompt: Why might Omar need to return to the clinic?
context: Omar arrived at the clinic at 9:30. The nurse checked his temperature before his 10:00 appointment. The doctor said he did not have a fever and asked him to come back if his cough became worse. Omar went home without medicine.
options: If the nurse checks his temperature.
If he goes home without medicine.
explanationAr: الدكتور قال لعمر يرجع لو الكحة بقت أسوأ، وده سبب إنه ممكن يحتاج يرجع العيادة.

prompt: When does Dina plan to visit the clinic?
context: Hi Salma, I have a sore throat, but I’m at work this morning. I’ll finish at 4:30 and visit the clinic at 5. Could you send me the notes from today’s meeting? Thanks, Dina.
explanationAr: دينا قالت إنها هتخلص الشغل الساعة ٤:٣٠ وتروح العيادة الساعة ٥، يعني بعد الشغل.

prompt: How much longer does Rana walk now than she did before?
context: Rana’s doctor suggested that she walk regularly. In the first week, she walked for 10 minutes each evening. This week, she walks for 20 minutes each evening. She says the longer walk feels easy, so she plans to continue.
explanationAr: كانت بتمشي ١٠ دقايق وبقت ٢٠، يعني زادت “10 minutes longer”.

prompt: Can a customer buy medicine at Green Street Pharmacy at 8 p.m. on Sunday?
context: Green Street Pharmacy opens from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday to Saturday. On Sunday, it opens from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. A sign inside says customers can ask the pharmacist questions about their medicine.
options: Yes, because it is open until 8 p.m. every day.
No, because it sells medicine only on weekdays.
No, because it closes at 2 p.m. on Sunday.
Yes, because the pharmacist answers questions.
explanationAr: الصيدلية بتقفل يوم الأحد الساعة ٢، فمش هتكون مفتوحة الساعة ٨ بالليل.

prompt: What does Kareem plan to do tomorrow?
context: Kareem hurt his ankle while playing football on Saturday. He rested at home on Sunday and Monday. Today, Tuesday, he can walk around his room, but he still has some pain. His doctor told him to wait until the pain is gone before playing football again. Kareem plans to visit his friend tomorrow instead.
options: Go to work with his doctor.
explanationAr: كريم مخطط يزور صاحبه بكرة، ومش هيلعب كورة لحد ما الألم يروح.

prompt: The shop assistant ___ the price of the blue shoes right now.
context: Mona is in a shoe shop. The assistant is checking the price at this moment.
explanationAr: استخدمنا is checking لأن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي، وعبارة right now بتوضح ده.

prompt: We ___ two bags at the market yesterday.
context: The shopping trip is finished. It happened yesterday.
explanationAr: استخدمنا bought لأن الشراء حصل وانتهى امبارح.

prompt: Omar ___ a larger suitcase next week.
context: Omar has already decided to buy a larger suitcase. The purchase is planned for next week.
explanationAr: استخدمنا is going to buy لأن عمر قرر بالفعل وهي خطة للأسبوع الجاي.

prompt: This jacket is ___ than that one. It costs £20, and the other jacket costs £30.
explanationAr: cheaper هي صيغة المقارنة الصحيحة مع than، والجُاكت سعره أقل.

prompt: How ___ rice do we need for dinner?
context: Rice is sold by weight, so the question is about its amount.
explanationAr: بنستخدم much مع rice لأنه اسم غير معدود.

prompt: Keep the ___ from the shop. You may need this small piece of paper to show what you paid for the shirt.
explanationAr: receipt يعني الإيصال اللي بتاخده بعد الدفع، وبيوضح إنت دفعت كام مقابل القميص.

prompt: I want to see if these trousers fit. Where is the ___?
context: The customer is inside a clothes shop and wants to try on the trousers.
explanationAr: fitting room هي غرفة قياس الملابس قبل الشراء.

prompt: The shop has a 20% ___ on all bags this week, so they cost less than usual.
explanationAr: discount معناها تخفيض، وده بيخلّي الشنط أرخص من المعتاد.

prompt: The person whose job is to take customers' payments in a shop is called a ___.
explanationAr: cashier يعني موظف الكاشير، وشغلته إنه يستلم المدفوعات من الزباين.

prompt: I need a ___ to carry these apples around the supermarket.
explanationAr: basket هي السلة اللي بتحط فيها المشتريات وإنت بتتسوق.

prompt: Customer: Which of these two coats is warmer? Shop assistant: ___
context: The customer is comparing two coats. One coat has a thicker lining.
options: They are both on the shelf.
The blue one; it has a thicker lining.
explanationAr: الرد بيجاوب عن الدفا بوضوح: الجاكت الأزرق بطانته أسمك.

prompt: Customer: Could I try these trousers on? Shop assistant: ___
context: The customer is in a clothes shop and wants to try on the trousers.
options: Yes, the fitting rooms are over there.
They are twenty pounds a pair.
No, the shop opens at nine.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب على طلب القياس هو توجيه الزبون لغرف القياس.

prompt: Customer: How much are these oranges? Shop assistant: ___
context: The oranges are sold by weight, and the price is 80 pounds per kilo.
options: The apples are next to them.
explanationAr: الرد بيذكر السعر والوزن المطلوبين: 80 جنيه للكيلو.

prompt: Customer: I bought these shoes yesterday, but they are too small. I haven't worn them, and I have the receipt. Shop assistant: ___
context: The shop allows customers with a receipt to exchange unworn shoes for another size.
options: You can exchange them for a larger pair.
You should wear them every day.
explanationAr: الزبون معاه الإيصال ولسه ملبسش الجزمة، فحسب سياسة المحل يقدر يبدّلها بمقاس أكبر.

prompt: Customer: I need milk, but I don't want a large bottle. Shop assistant: ___
context: The shop has both small and large bottles of milk.
options: Would you like a shopping basket?
The large bottles are on the top shelf.
explanationAr: الزبون مش عايز زجاجة كبيرة، فالرد المناسب هو إن فيه زجاجات صغيرة موجودة.

prompt: Why did Dina choose the blue backpack?
context: Dina compared two backpacks in a shop. The green one cost 450 pounds, and the blue one cost 390 pounds. The blue backpack was large enough for her books, so she bought it.
options: It was cheaper and big enough for her books.
It had more pockets than the green one.
It was the only backpack in the shop.
explanationAr: اختارت الشنطة الزرقا لأنها أرخص، وكانت واسعة كفاية لكتبها.

prompt: What does Sam still need to buy?
context: Sam sent his sister a message: “I went to the supermarket at seven. I bought apples and milk, but there were no eggs left. I’ll go back tomorrow morning.”
explanationAr: لسه محتاج يشتري eggs لأن مكنش فيه بيض متاح وقت ما راح.

prompt: Can Noor exchange the shoes according to the shop's rule?
context: Noor ordered shoes online and received them on Monday. They were too small, but she had not worn them. She asked the shop for an exchange on Wednesday. The shop's rule said customers can exchange unworn shoes within seven days of receiving them.
options: No, because the shoes were too small.
No, because she bought the shoes in a shop.
Yes, because the shoes are unworn and she asked within seven days.
Yes, but only after one month.
explanationAr: أيوه، نور ملبستش الجزمة وطلبت تبديلها يوم الأربعاء بعد ما استلمتها يوم الاثنين، يعني خلال سبعة أيام. كده الشرطين متحققين.

prompt: How much did Hany pay for the tomatoes?
context: Hany bought vegetables at the market. He chose one kilo of tomatoes at 30 pounds per kilo and half a kilo of carrots at 20 pounds per kilo. He paid for both items together.
explanationAr: هاني اشترى كيلو طماطم، وسعر الكيلو 30 جنيه، يبقى دفع 30 جنيه للطماطم بس. السؤال مش عن إجمالي المشتريات.

prompt: When can Salma go to buy a bag from the new stock?
context: Salma read a message from Green Street Shop: “We open from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day except Sunday. Our new school bags will be ready to buy when we open this Thursday.” She wants to buy a bag from the new stock.
explanationAr: تقدر تروح الخميس الساعة 11 الصبح، لأن الشنط الجديدة هتكون جاهزة للبيع من وقت فتح المحل الساعة 10. المحل مقفول الأحد وبيقفل الساعة 6 مساءً.

prompt: Mona usually ___ the daily report before lunch.
context: This describes Mona’s current daily routine.
explanationAr: الإجابة «writes»؛ بنتكلم عن عادة حالية، فبنستخدم المضارع البسيط. ومع «Mona» بنضيف s للفعل.

prompt: Last Friday, the office was closed, so we ___ from home.
context: The sentence describes a completed day last week.
explanationAr: الإجابة «worked»؛ كلمة «Last Friday» بتوضح إن الحدث حصل وانتهى في الماضي.

prompt: Please be quiet; the manager ___ to a client right now.
explanationAr: الإجابة «is talking»؛ «right now» معناها إن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي.

prompt: I promise I ___ you the updated file this afternoon.
context: The speaker is making a promise about later today.
explanationAr: الإجابة «will send»؛ بنستخدمها هنا لوعد بالمستقبل، و«this afternoon» بتحدد وقت لاحق.

prompt: The new printer is ___ than the old one. It prints 30 pages a minute, while the old one prints 20.
explanationAr: الإجابة «faster»؛ بنستخدم صيغة المقارنة «faster than» لما نقارن بين طابعتين.

prompt: Rami checks his ___ before leaving home to see what time his shift starts.
explanationAr: الإجابة «schedule»، يعني جدول المواعيد، وهو اللي يراجع منه وقت بداية الشيفت.

prompt: There is a small ___ where staff can make tea and eat lunch.
explanationAr: الإجابة «break room»؛ دي غرفة الاستراحة اللي الموظفين ممكن ياكلوا فيها أو يعملوا شاي.

prompt: The form is open on the computer. Please ___ the customer’s name in the box.
explanationAr: الإجابة «type»؛ معناها تكتب باستخدام لوحة المفاتيح، وده مناسب لأن النموذج مفتوح على الكمبيوتر.

prompt: The office is low on paper and envelopes, so we need to order more ___.
explanationAr: الإجابة «supplies»؛ معناها مستلزمات، زي الورق والأظرف اللي محتاجين نطلب منها كمية أكتر.

prompt: Before joining the company, Hany helped customers in a shop for six months. He has some customer-service ___.
explanationAr: الإجابة «experience»؛ معناها خبرة. هاني كان بيساعد الزباين في محل لمدة ست شهور، فبقى عنده خبرة في خدمة العملاء.

prompt: A: Could you repeat the room number, please? B: ___
explanationAr: الرد المناسب «Sure, it’s room 14» لأنه بيكرر رقم الغرفة المطلوب.

prompt: A: I have a dentist appointment at 4. Could I leave work at 3:30 today? B: ___
context: The manager agrees, but reminds the employee to complete a task first.
options: You should take the earlier bus.
No, I don’t have a dentist.
Of course. Please finish the report before you go.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب «Of course. Please finish the report before you go»؛ المدير وافق ووضّح المطلوب قبل ما الموظف يمشي.

prompt: A: Excuse me, where’s the photocopier? B: ___
explanationAr: الرد المناسب «Across from the reception desk» لأنه بيوضح مكان آلة التصوير.

prompt: A: These boxes are heavy. B: ___
context: The second speaker is offering help.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب «I’ll help you carry them»؛ ده عرض مساعدة مباشر لحمل الصناديق.

prompt: A: I keep forgetting my work tasks. What should I do? B: ___
options: Write them in a daily list.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب «Write them in a daily list»؛ دي نصيحة واضحة تساعد على تذكّر المهام.

prompt: What time does tomorrow’s meeting start?
context:
Hi Salma,
The 9:00 meeting has moved to 10:30 tomorrow. Please bring the sales notes. I will be at my desk until 9:45 if you have questions.
—Omar
explanationAr: الإجابة «At 10:30»؛ الرسالة بتقول إن الاجتماع اتنقل لمعاد 10:30 بكرة.

prompt: What time does Nour usually finish work on days other than Tuesday?
context: Nour works in a bakery office. She starts at 8:00, checks orders until 10:00, and then answers customer emails. She takes lunch at 1:00. On Tuesdays, she leaves at 4:00, one hour earlier than usual.
explanationAr: الإجابة «At 5:00»؛ يوم الثلاثاء بتخرج 4:00، وده أبكر بساعة من معادها المعتاد.

prompt: How many fans did Karim repair before lunch?
context: At the repair shop, Karim opens at 9. On Monday, three customers brought in broken fans. He repaired two before lunch and finished the last one at 3 p.m. He wrote each customer’s phone number on a job card.
explanationAr: الإجابة «Two»؛ المقطع بيقول إنه صلّح مروحتين قبل الغدا.

prompt: Why does Ibrahim take an earlier bus now?
context: Ibrahim started at the hotel office last month. He used to take a bus that arrived at 8:20, but his shift begins at 8:00. Now he takes an earlier bus and arrives at 7:45. He spends the first 15 minutes preparing front-desk papers.
options: His old bus was always empty.
His shift begins before his old bus arrives.
He wants to work at a different hotel.
explanationAr: الإجابة «His shift begins before his old bus arrives»؛ الشيفت بيبدأ 8:00، لكن الأتوبيس القديم كان بيوصل 8:20.

prompt: What is Leila learning to do at Green Desk?
context: Before joining Green Desk, Leila worked in a small shop for two years. She greeted customers and counted cash, but she never used a computer at work. At Green Desk, she enters orders on a computer and is learning to make weekly reports.
explanationAr: الإجابة «Make weekly reports»؛ المقطع بيقول إنها بتتعلم تعمل تقارير أسبوعية.

prompt: The bus ___ five minutes late yesterday.
context: The sentence describes a finished journey from yesterday.
explanationAr: كلمة yesterday بتدل على وقت ماضي وانتهى، فالصيغة الصحيحة هي arrived.

prompt: Please wait here. The driver ___ the route on his phone now.
context: The driver is doing this action at this moment.
explanationAr: كلمة now بتوضح إن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي، فبنستخدم is checking.

prompt: I promise I ___ for you outside the station at six tomorrow.
context: The speaker is making a promise about tomorrow.
explanationAr: الوعد هنا عن بكرة، فبنستخدم will wait. الصيغ الماضية مش مناسبة، وwaits ما تنفعش مع I.

prompt: At 8 a.m., the metro is ___ than the bus in this city.
context: Compare the travel time: the metro takes 20 minutes and the bus takes 35 minutes.
explanationAr: بنستخدم faster للمقارنة بين وسيلتين؛ المترو أسرع من الأتوبيس هنا.

prompt: How ___ bags can we take on the bus?
context: The speaker is asking about the number of bags. Bags are countable.
explanationAr: بنسأل عن عدد أشياء قابلة للعد باستخدام many؛ الصياغة هي How many bags.

prompt: The bus is packed: every seat is taken and people are standing. What does “packed” mean here?
context: You are waiting to get on a very crowded bus.
explanationAr: packed معناها مزدحم جدًا، وده واضح لأن كل المقاعد مشغولة وفي ناس واقفة.

prompt: At the end of this street, turn left where the two roads meet. What is this place called?
context: A person is giving you directions to the station.
explanationAr: المكان اللي بيتقابل فيه طريقان اسمه junction.

prompt: Take bus 12, then get off at Central Square and ___ to bus 5.
context: You need to use two different buses to reach the airport.
explanationAr: change to bus 5 معناها تنزل من الأتوبيس الأول وتكمل بأتوبيس 5.

prompt: “The taxi dropped me off outside the library.” What does “dropped me off” mean?
context: A passenger is describing the end of a taxi journey.
options: The taxi waited for me there.
The taxi picked me up there.
The taxi drove past me there.
explanationAr: dropped me off معناها إن التاكسي نزّلني في المكان ده.

prompt: The bus ticket costs 15 pounds. This is the bus ___.
context: You are asking how much you need to pay for a bus journey.
explanationAr: fare معناها أجرة المواصلات، يعني المبلغ اللي بتدفعه مقابل الرحلة.

prompt: Passenger: “I need to go to the City Museum. Does this bus stop there?” Driver: “No, it doesn’t.” Passenger: “___”
context: The passenger wants to ask for the right bus after learning this bus does not stop at the museum.
options: Where did you buy this bus?
Which bus should I take, then?
explanationAr: السؤال المناسب بعد ما عرف إن الأتوبيس مش بيقف هناك هو Which bus should I take, then?

prompt: Visitor: “Excuse me, I’m looking for the train station.” Local person: “It’s near the bank.” Visitor: “___”
context: The visitor needs clear directions from the current place.
options: Could you sell me a train?
Could you tell me how to get there?
explanationAr: لطلب الاتجاهات بطريقة مهذبة، نقول Could you tell me how to get there?

prompt: Passenger: “The train is not stopping here today. Where should I change to the replacement bus?” Staff member: “At Gate 2.” Passenger: “___”
context: The passenger wants to check where to find the bus.
options: So the train is faster, right?
So I should go to Gate 2, right?
So I should buy a car, right?
So I should wait until tomorrow, right?
explanationAr: الراكب بيتأكد من المكان اللي قاله الموظف، فالسؤال المناسب هو So I should go to Gate 2, right?

prompt: Mona: “I have two heavy bags, and the bus stop is far away.” Karim: “___”
context: Karim is giving practical advice for getting to the stop with the bags.
options: The bus stop was far away.
explanationAr: للإرشاد والنصيحة بنستخدم You should؛ اقتراح أخذ تاكسي مناسب للشنط التقيلة.

prompt: Passenger: “Turn left after the pharmacy, then walk to the second bus stop.” Friend: “___”
context: The friend did not hear all the directions and wants the passenger to repeat them more slowly.
options: Could you say that again more slowly?
Would you like a new ticket?
Could you turn the bus off?
explanationAr: الصديق ما سمعش الاتجاهات كويس، فبيطلب تكرارها ببطء: Could you say that again more slowly?

prompt: What should Salma do when she reaches the library?
context: Message from Salma’s brother: “The number 6 bus is not going to the hospital today because River Street is closed. Take the number 6 to the library, then get off and take the number 9 bus. It stops outside the hospital.”
options: Stay on bus 6 until the hospital.
Walk from the library to the hospital.
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن سلمى تنزل عند المكتبة وتركب أتوبيس 9، لأنه بيقف قدام المستشفى.

prompt: How does Omar usually travel to work?
context: Omar says: “My office is close to the metro station, so I take the metro most days. It takes 25 minutes. The bus takes about 40 minutes, but I use it when the metro is busy. On Fridays, I walk because the office is only a short distance from my home.”
explanationAr: عمر بيقول إنه بياخد المترو معظم الأيام، فوسيلته المعتادة هي المترو.

prompt: Where should passengers wait for the 7:30 train to Mansoura?
context: Station message: “The 7:30 train to Mansoura will leave from platform 4 today, not platform 2. Passengers can enter platform 4 from the main hall. The train is on time.”
explanationAr: الرسالة بتوضح إن قطار المنصورة هيطلع النهارده من platform 4.

prompt: What will Nader do if the taxi has not arrived by 7:10?
context: Nader texts his friend: “My taxi is late. The driver says he may arrive at 7:10. If he isn’t here by then, I’ll take the 7:15 bus from the stop opposite the bakery. I need to reach the station before 7:45.”
options: He will wait until 7:45 for the taxi.
He will take a bus from the station.
He will walk to the station.
explanationAr: نادر بيقول إنه لو التاكسي ما وصلش بحلول 7:10، هيركب أتوبيس 7:15.

prompt: Which way should Lina walk from the bus stop to the clinic?
context: Lina reads this message: “Get off bus 3 at Green Square. Walk straight along Palm Street. The clinic is on your right, just after the post office. Do not cross the bridge.”
options: Walk past the clinic and stop at the post office.
Walk straight on Palm Street and look on the right after the post office.
Turn left at Green Square and walk to the bridge.
Cross the bridge and look on the left.
explanationAr: التعليمات بتقول تمشي مستقيم في Palm Street، والعيادة على اليمين بعد مكتب البريد.

prompt: Look! The caretaker ___ the front gate.
context: The action is happening right now.
explanationAr: لأن الفعل بيحصل دلوقتي، نقول: “is repairing”.

prompt: We ___ the new neighbours last Saturday.
context: The visit happened last Saturday and is finished.
explanationAr: الزيارة حصلت وانتهت السبت اللي فات، فنستخدم الماضي “met”.

prompt: I think our street ___ quieter after the roadworks finish.
context: Use a simple prediction about the future, introduced by “I think.”
explanationAr: للتوقع عن المستقبل بعد “I think”، نقول: “will be”.

prompt: This bedroom is ___ than the one next to it.
context: You are comparing the rooms. The first bedroom has more floor space.
explanationAr: للمقارنة بين غرفتين نقول “larger than”.

prompt: There aren't ___ chairs for six visitors; we have only two.
context: Choose the word that means the number of chairs is sufficient.
explanationAr: الكراسي مش كفاية لستة زوار، فنقول “aren't enough chairs”.

prompt: Water is coming out from under the kitchen sink. There is a ___ in the pipe.
context: Choose the word for this problem in a pipe.
explanationAr: خروج الميه من الماسورة معناه إن فيها “leak”، أي تسرّب.

prompt: The building has no lift, so we walk up the ___ to our flat on the third floor.
explanationAr: بنطلع للدور التالت على “stairs”، يعني السلالم.

prompt: I need some medicine for my cough. Is there a ___ near here?
context: Choose the kind of shop that sells medicine.
explanationAr: المكان اللي بيبيع الدوا هو “pharmacy”، يعني صيدلية.

prompt: We rent this flat from Mr Hassan and pay him every month. He is our ___.
explanationAr: الشخص اللي بنستأجر منه الشقة هو “landlord”، يعني مالك العقار.

prompt: Please put the clean cups on the ___ above the kitchen counter.
context: Choose the household item used to hold things on a wall.
explanationAr: بنحط الأكواب على “shelf”، يعني رف.

prompt:
A: The TV is very loud. Could you turn it down, please?
B: ___
options: Yes, I turned it on yesterday.
Of course. I'll make it quieter.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب على طلب خفض الصوت هو: “Of course. I'll make it quieter.”

prompt:
A: Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?
B: ___
context: From here, walk straight to the next corner, then turn left onto Green Street. The post office is on that street.
options: You can post a letter there.
Go straight and turn left onto Green Street.
It closes at six every evening.
I live near the post office.
explanationAr: السؤال عن الطريق لمكتب البريد، فالرد المناسب بيوضح الاتجاهات: امشي على طول وبعدين ادخل شمال في Green Street.

prompt:
A: I can't carry these boxes up the stairs by myself.
B: ___
options: Would you like me to help you?
The stairs are above the flat.
explanationAr: الرد الطبيعي هنا عرض المساعدة: “Would you like me to help you?”

prompt:
A: There's water on the bathroom floor, and the tap won't stop dripping.
B: ___
context: The tap needs fixing.
options: You should buy a larger table.
You should wait for the postman.
explanationAr: بما إن الحنفية محتاجة تصليح، النصيحة المناسبة هي: “You should call a plumber.”

prompt:
A: Could I have two bottles of water, please?
B: ___
context: You are buying drinks at a local shop.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب على طلب الشراء هو: “Certainly. Here you are.”

prompt: Where did Mina leave the spare key?
context:
Hi Salma,
I'm at the supermarket. The spare key is under the flowerpot beside our front door. Please use it if you get home before me.
Mina
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إن المفتاح الاحتياطي “under the flowerpot” جنب الباب الأمامي.

prompt: On which day does the garden stay open until 6 p.m.?
context:
NEIGHBOURHOOD GARDEN
The garden is open from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday to Friday. On Saturday, it closes at 6 p.m. It is closed on Sunday. Please use the side gate.
explanationAr: المعلومة بتقول إن الحديقة بتقفل الساعة 6 يوم “Saturday”.

prompt: Why did Omar ask the shop to deliver the lamp instead of taking it home himself?
context: Omar chose a lamp at the home shop, but it was too large to carry on his bicycle. He paid for delivery and asked the shop to bring it the next morning, when he would be at home.
options: He did not have a bicycle.
The lamp was too large to carry on his bicycle.
The shop was closed the next morning.
He wanted to buy another lamp.
explanationAr: عمر طلب توصيل اللمبة لأنها كانت كبيرة ومش هيقدر يشيلها على عجلته.

prompt: Which flat has more bedrooms?
context: Nadia is moving to a new building. Flat 2 has one bedroom and a small balcony. Flat 5 has two bedrooms but no balcony. Both flats have a kitchen and a bathroom.
options: They have the same number of bedrooms.
explanationAr: الشقة 5 فيها أوضتين نوم، لكن الشقة 2 فيها أوضة نوم واحدة، فالشقة 5 فيها أوض نوم أكتر.

prompt: Which service will be available again at 10 a.m. on Tuesday?
context:
Dear residents,
The building's water will be turned off on Tuesday from 8 a.m. until 10 a.m. while workers repair a pipe. Please fill any bottles you need before 8 a.m. Normal water service will return at 10 a.m.
Building office
explanationAr: الإعلان بيقول إن الميه هترجع الساعة 10 صباحًا يوم التلات بعد تصليح الماسورة.

prompt: Last night, we ___ our neighbors to dinner.
context: The dinner was yesterday evening.
explanationAr: استخدمنا الماضي البسيط لأن الدعوة كانت امبارح: “invited”.

prompt: Please wait a minute. The guests ___ outside now.
context: The guests are waiting at the door at this moment.
explanationAr: كلمة “now” بتوضح إن الانتظار بيحصل دلوقتي، فالصحيح “are waiting”.

prompt: I ___ you the address after I check it.
context: The speaker promises to send the address later today.
explanationAr: المتكلم بيوعد إنه هيبعت العنوان بعد ما يتأكد منه، فبنستخدم “will send” للتعبير عن الوعد في المستقبل.

prompt: The small room is ___ than the hall, so let's meet in the hall.
context: The speaker is comparing the size of two rooms.
explanationAr: بنقارن بين مكانين، والصيغة الصحيحة للمقارنة هي “smaller than”.

prompt: There are twelve guests and twelve cups. We have ___ cups for everyone.
context: Each guest needs one cup.
explanationAr: عندنا عدد أكواب يكفي كل الضيوف، فالكلمة المناسبة هي “enough”.

prompt: Mona asked her friends to come to dinner at her home. She ___ them to dinner.
context: Choose the word that means asking someone to come to an event.
explanationAr: مونا طلبت من أصحابها ييجوا يتعشوا عندها، يعني عزمتهم. كلمة “invited” معناها عزمت أو دعت.

prompt: Omar is ___ on Friday evening, so he can come to our game night.
context: Omar has no work or other plans at that time.
explanationAr: لأن عمر مافيش عنده شغل أو خطط تانية، فهو “available”، يعني متاح.

prompt: The invitation says, “The dinner will be outdoors.” What does “outdoors” mean?
context: The friends will eat at tables in the café's garden.
explanationAr: كلمة “outdoors” معناها برّه المبنى أو في الهوا الطلق، وده مناسب لأنهم هياكلوا في الجنينة.

prompt: We should book a table. This café is very ___ tonight, with many people inside.
context: Choose the word that best describes the café.
explanationAr: وجود ناس كتير جوه معناه إن المكان “crowded”، أي مزدحم.

prompt: “Would you like to join us for lunch?” What does “join us” mean here?
context: A friend is inviting you to have lunch with a group.
explanationAr: “Join us” هنا معناها تيجي تاكل الغدا مع المجموعة.

prompt: A: Could you open the window, please? B: ___
context: The room is warm, and the speaker is making a polite request.
explanationAr: الرد المهذب على الطلب هو “Certainly. I'll open it now.”

prompt: A: Would you like to come to dinner on Saturday? B: ___
context: B cannot attend because they have a work shift that evening.
options: Thanks for inviting me, but I have to work that evening.
Dinner is usually in the evening.
Yes, Saturday is a day of the week.
explanationAr: ده رد مهذب بيرفض الدعوة وبيوضح السبب: “I have to work that evening.”

prompt: A: Could I borrow your pen for a moment? B: ___
context: B has a spare pen and is happy to lend it.
options: The pen is blue and long.
explanationAr: بما إن الشخص موافق يدي القلم، الرد الطبيعي هو “Of course. Here you are.”

prompt: A: Could you send me the address for the party? B: ___
context: B has the address on their phone and can send it now.
options: Please arrive before you invite me.
The party was fun last week.
explanationAr: الرد المناسب على الطلب هو “Sure, I'll send it now.”

prompt: A: I'm not sure what to bring to the picnic. B: ___
context: The host has already asked everyone to bring water.
options: The picnic is bigger than the park.
You should bring some water; the host asked everyone to.
explanationAr: النصيحة المناسبة هي “You should bring some water”، وده كمان حسب طلب المضيف.

prompt: What time should guests arrive?
context: Passage: Hi everyone, I'd love you to join me for a picnic in Riverside Park this Sunday. Please meet by the main gate at 12:30. Bring a bottle of water; I'll bring sandwiches and fruit. Text me if you can come. —Laila
explanationAr: الرسالة بتقول إنهم هيتقابلوا عند البوابة الساعة “12:30”.

prompt: What does Hany ask Sami to do by Tuesday?
context: Passage: Hello, Sami. We're having dinner at our home on Thursday at 7 p.m. You don't need to bring food—we've prepared everything. Please reply by Tuesday so we know how many people to expect. Best, Hany
explanationAr: هاني طالب من سامي يرد ويقول إذا كان هييجي، عشان يعرفوا عدد الناس. “By Tuesday” معناها يوم التلات كحد أقصى.

prompt: Where will the evening class meet?
context: Passage: Dear neighbors, You're invited to our free English conversation class on Wednesday at 6:30 p.m. The class has moved from Room 2 to Room 5. Please bring a notebook. You can ask for directions at the front desk. —The Community Center
explanationAr: الإعلان واضح إن مكان الفصل اتغير من Room 2 إلى “Room 5”.

prompt: Why will the birthday party be inside?
context: Passage: Hi Noor, My birthday party is on Saturday at 4 p.m. We planned to sit in the garden, but rain is expected that afternoon, so we'll use the living room instead. Please come through the front door. I hope you can make it! —Dina
options: The party starts in the morning.
Noor asked to change the room.
explanationAr: دينا بتقول إنهم هيستخدموا غرفة المعيشة لأن المطر متوقع بعد الضهر.

prompt: When are the two friends planning to meet for coffee?
context:
Passage: Hi Alex, Thanks for inviting me for coffee. I can't meet on Monday because I have a dentist appointment. Tuesday morning is free for me. Would 10 a.m. work? Please let me know. —Rita
Reply: Tuesday at 10 is perfect. See you then! —Alex
explanationAr: ريتا اقترحت يوم التلات الساعة 10، وأليكس وافق على الموعد ده.

prompt: Last Saturday, Kareem ___ his parents at their new flat.
context: The sentence describes a finished visit last Saturday.
explanationAr: كلمة Last Saturday بتوضح إن الزيارة حصلت وخلصت في الماضي، فالصيغة الصحيحة هي visited.

prompt: Please be quiet. The baby ___ right now.
context: Use the present continuous for an action happening at this moment.
explanationAr: right now معناها إن الحدث بيحصل دلوقتي، فبنقول is sleeping.

prompt: We decided yesterday to stay in this Sunday. We are ___ a film at home.
context: Sunday has not arrived yet.
